name: What is hydro-jetting and when is it used for drain cleaning?

mainEntity.name: What is hydro-jetting and when is it used for drain cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hydro-jetting is a powerful drain cleaning method that uses high-pressure water streams to blast away stubborn clogs, grease buildup, mineral deposits, and even tree roots from pipes. It's often used for severe blockages, main sewer lines, or as a preventative measure to thoroughly clean pipes. Hydro-jetting can restore pipes to near original condition and is highly effective where traditional snaking may not be sufficient.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hydro-jetting uses high-pressure water to clear severe clogs, grease, and roots from pipes. It's used for stubborn blockages or main sewer lines when snaking isn't enough.
